workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I've checked Priya's and Marcus's calendars. Here are the 30-minute slots they have free for the meeting next week. Can you please check these against Elena's and David's calendars?

Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00, 14:30
Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Let me know which of these times works for them.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, I've checked with Elena's and David's calendars. Unfortunately, none of the slots you proposed work. I've compiled a list of all the 30-minute slots where Elena and David are both free. Can you please check this against Priya's and Marcus's calendars?

Mon: 11:00, 11:30
Tue: 09:00, 09:30
Wed: 13:00, 13:30
Thu: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00
Fri: 15:00, 15:30

Let me know which of these work on your end.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Thanks Brad. I've checked the new list against Priya's and Marcus's calendars. The only time that works for everyone is Thursday at 14:30. I'll book it now. Please send the confirmation email to all partners for this time.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: I booked the meeting for Thu 14:30 and asked you to send the confirmation. Can you confirm the email has been sent?

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison, I can confirm that the email has been sent.

emails.body: All four partners are available to meet for 30 minutes at 14:30 on Thursday, November 19. This email confirms that a meeting has been booked at this time.
